text:
maria: quick thought  condense left nav to 3 anchors (Projects, Model hub, Observability) and move other items to flyouts. aim: declutter + make permalinks predictable.

sam: agree on declutter. main concern: breadcrumb stability for copy/paste and external links.

lina: breadcrumbs should always expose the full logical path (Org > Project > Model > Versions) even when the sidebar label is compacted. keeps automation/scripts stable.

ethan: accessibility nit: when a flyout opens via keyboard, focus must land inside and we should announce the flyout name with aria-live. also ensure keyboard expand/collapse uses Enter/Space and is reachable via tab order.

sam: routing question: can we standardize on full-path URLs and reserve hashes for ephemeral UI state? e.g. `/orgs/:org/projects/:p/models/:id?panel=metrics` vs `#ui=inspect`

maria: yes — canonical full-paths for permalinks, query params for durable view state, hashes only for ephemeral toggles. also propose a routing shim to translate old hash routes for a migration window.

lina: copy tweak: prefer "Model hub" when compacted — reads better in a short label. breadcrumbs should continue to use resource names (not UI labels).

prod-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/compact-nav-a11y (preview/compact-nav-a11y) with routing shim and basic aria-live prototypes.

sam: I'll run a quick a11y sweep tomorrow (focus order, announcements, link text, keyboard expand/collapse).

maria: next steps: 1) share updated mock 2) eng add legacy-route telemetry 3) sam validate a11y 4) product lock query param contract. thanks all :sparkles:
